name: UMMC
verdict: Founded and owned by Iskander Makhmudov (US Treasury designation notice, September 2023). Nothing found.
note: Club sponsor of HC Avtomobilist per the club's sponsors page (archived capture of 8 July 2025; the page footer calls ОАО «УГМК» the club's general sponsor). UMMC also holds arena naming rights (УГМК Арена). US/UK/NZ sanctions on Makhmudov and UMMC are not human-rights findings under the method.
